{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or shows strong bearish signals (e.g., sentiment < 0.00).",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent price spikes — if last 5-7 days show upward momentum, apply a lagged correction to avoid overshoot.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias for 3-5 day horizons: if forecast is significantly above true outcome, reduce by 5-10% of the gap.",
    "For sentiment-neutral or mildly bullish periods, increase forecast volatility by 5-10% to account for potential overconfidence in model.",
    "When sentiment is bullish (e.g., > 0.33), apply a 3-5 day smoothing filter to avoid overreaction to short-term noise.",
    "Correct for persistent underestimation in high volatility periods — if true outcome consistently exceeds forecast by > 5%, apply a 10-15% upward bias adjustment.",
    "In low volatility regimes, reduce forecast variance — avoid overfitting to recent noise, especially if sentiment is flat or negative."
  ]
}
